description: Proposes changing land use from urban to rural commercial industrial.
Removes Grasswood Road site from future urban growth plan.
This application is for land in the RM of Corman Park.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois questioned risks of approving the change outside the concept plan.
Grasswood Ventures and Major Land Corp are the applicants.
Applicant's planner explained delays and RM of Corman Park's support.
Administration will identify replacement lands for urban commercial/industrial designation.

segments.title: First Reading of the Bylaw
segments.takeaway: Council passed the first reading of the bylaw to amend the Saskatoon North Partnership for Growth District Official Community Plan land use map.

segments.title: Questions for Administration
segments.takeaway: Councillors questioned administration about the risks, implications, and alignment of the proposed land use changes with the city's long-term growth plans.

segments.title: Public Presentations
segments.takeaway: The chair opened the floor for public presentations, and the applicant's consultant spoke in support of the land use map amendment.

segments.title: Questions for the Applicant
segments.takeaway: Councillors questioned the applicant's consultant regarding the status of the southeast concept plan and the city's partnership in its development.

segments.title: Receive Reports and Close Public Hearing
segments.takeaway: Council moved to receive the reports and officially close the public hearing for the land use map amendment application.

segments.title: Second and Third Readings of the Bylaw
segments.takeaway: Council proceeded with and unanimously passed the second and third readings of the bylaw for the land use map amendment.
